supplied_context: Current canonical sparse Gaussian research note
independence: Internal source-aware review; shared checker, not a separate implementation or blind reader.
claim_scope: No Gaussian-moment counterexample has both total degree at most four and at most four nonzero monomials in a fixed Gaussian Witt frame; the three surviving coefficient families satisfy the all-order mixed conclusion.
findings_and_resolution: Removed product-order/Pareto minimality inference: the excluded rectangle does not exclude a five-term cubic.
Explained coefficient-torus support coverage and why finite equations only supply necessary conditions.
Added self-contained one-row charge bound, parity generation, bounded-weight deduction, and detailed Gaussian shear invariance.
Kept deposited PDF/source/checker archive bytes intact and moved them to published/.

PDF-reader feedback: identified the supplied source.zip, named the exact supplement/checker/helper with SHA256 digests in Section 5, and specified that the unique-contraction filter runs through order twenty as a sufficient rejection filter.

observed: all 59535 raw supports in degree<=4 and terms<=4 covered by exact rational pass
moments<=24 leave exactly three genuine coefficient families
displayed coefficient equations and product factorization checked
exact_replay.limits: Legacy output uses Pareto terminology; only the bounded rectangle and displayed algebra are certified. The analytic/algebraic all-order arguments require reading the article.

pdf_visual_review.method: Rendered all six pages with PyMuPDF and inspected the complete contact sheet plus full-size charge-bound, saturation and all-order calculation pages.
pdf_visual_review.findings: No clipped text, overlaps, unreadable formulas or unresolved references. Main theorem kept together on page 2.
pdf_visual_review.reader_followup: Rebuilt after supplement identification and filter-cutoff clarification; affected pages 4 and 6 inspected at full size, including artifact filenames/digests and bibliography. No clipping or layout defects; six-page length retained.

isolated_pdf_only_review.supplied_context: Only this manuscript PDF and the five reader questions. No conversation, repository content, other papers, external literature, source or supplement.

answers.contribution: Exclusion of GMC failure with both degree<=4 and at most four monomials in a fixed Witt frame; Long shows the five-term bound is sharp in degree<=4.
answers.mechanism: Exact support enumeration and saturated coefficient ideals leave three families, each reduced to one-sided isotropic weight by Gaussian-preserving transformations.
answers.hardest_step: Exhaustive elimination in Section3 pp.4-5; all-order bridge in Section4 pp.5-6.
answers.limitations: Simultaneous bounds and chosen coordinates are essential. The result does not exclude denser cubics or higher-degree four-term failures or establish global Pareto minimality.
answers.verification_obstacles: The essential exhaustive exclusions require the computational supplement. Final pp.4,6 specify the filter cutoff and precisely identify source.zip, both checker files and their hashes; no new issue found. Reviewer did not inspect/replay supplement.

formal_verification.scope: No Lean claim is made for this computer-assisted theorem.
